notes.text: Luke Evangelista is out (illness) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward. Dawson Mercer has taken his spot beside Timo Meier and Nico Hischier.
Connor Brown is out and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. Anthony Mantha has taken his spot beside Jesper Bratt and Jack Hughes.
Johnathan Kovacevic was added to the roster on Oct 11 and has played beside Declan Chisholm.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 7 games cover only 31% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 46%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Pierre-Luc Dubois is on injured reserve (illness) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward. Dylan Strome has taken his spot beside Tom Wilson and Alex Tuch.
Justin Sourdif is out (illness), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Rasmus Sandin is out long term (acl surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Vincent Desharnais has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry.
Justin Holl was added to the roster on Oct 16.

WSH.head: The Capitals face a real test
WSH.body: Even though New Jersey will be without Evangelista and Washington has home-ice advantage, the Devils have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Capitals will be without Sourdif. The Capitals can pull it off if they get good looks.

NJD.head: Advantage, the Devils
NJD.body: Even though New Jersey will be without Evangelista and Washington has home-ice advantage, the Devils have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Capitals will be without Sourdif. The Capitals’ way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: Bratt’s favorite opponent
paras: The Capitals are 4-3-0. The Devils have won two in a row, the last a 7-1 rout of the Rangers.
The Devils shoot a lot, and the Capitals give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.

items.text: Declan Chisholm faces his old team, Washington.
Jesper Bratt has a point in eight straight games against Washington, with a goal in each of the last three.
The Devils are newly without Luke Evangelista, and have had to make do without Connor Brown all season.
The Capitals are newly without Pierre-Luc Dubois and Justin Sourdif, and have had to make do without Rasmus Sandin all season.
